name: Free-space marker (demo patch)
description: A demo firmware patch that writes and reverts an inert marker in empty flash.

blocks.text: Free-space marker — a demo firmware patch

A **firmware patch** demo. It writes 8 bytes (`52 4F 4D 52 45 56 56 52` = "ROMREVVR") into **empty flash** and reverts them exactly. It is deliberately **inert**: nothing jumps to those bytes, so the ECU never runs them — it exists to show the code-patch install / preview / uninstall flow safely.

> ⚠️ ROM Revver never tests or endorses firmware patches. A *real* patch would also hook existing code to run its bytes — that part is the author's responsibility and can only be validated in a car.

The `original` bytes (`FF…`) are the erased-flash value at that address; ROM Revver refuses to install unless they match, so it never patches an unexpected ROM. The address is **per-ECU** (each calibration's free space differs) — this demo covers cal **60E1B900** (and its aliases N3ZBEH / N3ZDEH). Add a block for your own calibration id to cover more.
